clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia has marked four Hillsbrad humans for execution. She calls them enemies of the Forsaken for killing their people and striking at supplies.

Across the Hillsbrad Foothills, the fighting is brutal and personal. High Executor Darthalia and the Forsaken garrison at Tarren Mill see ordinary Hillsbrad citizens as deadly foes. A wanted notice names four people whose resistance has killed Forsaken and cost them valuable shipments from the Undercity.

The bounty names Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, who killed Deathguard Toma; Citizen Wilkes, who murdered Apothecary Eli; Miner Hackett, who killed Deathstalker Fry; and Farmer Kalaba, who sabotaged supply convoys from the Undercity. Each works from a different pocket of Hillsbrad resistance and remains elusive amid the wider conflict.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:
Clerk Horrace Whitesteed. Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.
Citizen Wilkes. Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.
Miner Hackett. Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.
Farmer Kalaba. Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.
All of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find. A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are quite the bounty hunter, adventurer. Well done.
